events.title: Martin Shkreli and GCR bet $1m on $DJT being real?

markets.question: Martin Shkreli and GCR bet $1m on $DJT being real?
markets.description:
On June 18, GCR (@GiganticRebirth) offered to bet Shkreli $100m on whether $DJT is real (see: https://x.com/GiganticRebirth/status/1803132945655538164)

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Martin Shkreli (@MartinShkreli) and GCR (@GiganticRebirth) confirm they have bet at least $1,000,000 by Friday, June 21, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No". 

In order for the bet to be 'confirmed' Shkreli must place at least $1,000,000 in escrow.

If it is publicly confirmed that either GCR or Martin Shkreli has payed out a bet to the other for $1,000,000 or more by the resolution date this market will resolve to "Yes". 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from GCR or definitive evidence confirming either Shkreli has escrowed the funds or the bet has been paid out.

events.title: Will GCR tweet again in April?

markets.question: Will GCR tweet again in April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if @GCRClassic and/or @GiganticRebirth posts/tweets again, between April 17, 2024, 12:00 PM ET and April 30, 2024, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, all quote and reply posts/tweets count toward a "Yes" resolution, but reposts/retweets will not count.

The resolution source for this market will be GCR's verified X/Twitter accounts: https://twitter.com/GCRClassic and/or https://twitter.com/GiganticRebirth.

Please note, only the verified @GCRClassic and/or @GiganticRebirth X/Twitter accounts count for this market, regardless of the URL for these profiles. If GCR posts/tweets from another account, it has no bearing on the resolution of this market.

events.title: Which guests will appear on the UpOnly podcast by December 31?
events.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if a new episode of the UpOnly podcast featuring the specified guest is publicly released by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.”

“Released” means the full episode is published and available to the general public on an official UpOnly platform (e.g. YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or the show’s official feed).

Previews, clips, teasers, or promotional material do not count toward resolution.

The resolution source will be the official UpOnly podcast channels and/or a consensus of credible public reporting.
